parts.text: 7.1. Definition. “ Confidential Information ” means all information obtained by the receiving party related to or provided by the disclosing party or its affiliates, and all information derived therefrom, but excludes information that: (a) is or becomes available to the general public other than through a breach of duty to the disclosing party; (b) was lawfully in the receiving party’s possession prior to receipt under this Agreement; (b) is independently developed by the receiving party without reference to Confidential Information; or (c) is subsequently obtained from a third party without restriction or breach of an obligation to the disclosing party. Confidential Information of Exos includes, without limitation, any PHI disclosed to Institution.

7.2. Obligations. Receiving party will protect Confidential Information of the disclosing party with reasonable care and will not disclose it to any third party, or use it for any purpose, except as permitted under this Agreement. Receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to persons who need to know it who are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than in this Section 7. Receiving party will be liable for any breach of this Section 7 by any person obtaining Confidential Information from it.  The foregoing notwithstanding, receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent necessary to comply with any law or governmental order if it first notifies disclosing party and provides it with an opportunity to prevent or limit such disclosure. To the extent permitted by law, receiving party will destroy Confidential Information of the disclosing party upon request, other than backup copies not readily accessible.

forms.label: more_protective
forms.reason: One-way protection of our information with a broad definition and a full student confidentiality agreement, in place of our mutual clause.

parts.text:
4.7. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. Student will be asked to sign and comply with the Student Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement.
16.1. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any “Confidential Information” of Exos. “ Confidential Information ” means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information (“ PHI ”) as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as “Confidential Information”).
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student’s agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student’s obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student’s involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party’s violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student’s possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student’s written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student’s agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys’ fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos’s rights hereunder.

This Educational Affiliation Agreement for Student Internships ("Agreement") is made effective this January 2, 2024 ("Effective Date") by and between [Exos affiliate], together with its affiliates ("Exos") and Counterparty-4 (the "Institution").
A. The Institution administers educational curricula for students pursuing careers in physical therapy, exercise science or other related health professions (each referenced herein as "Student," collectively, "Students"), and seeks to provide, as part of the educational curricula, supervised clinical experiences for Students at Exos' facilities (the "Program");
B. Exos seeks to provide Students of the Institution with supervised experiences at the Exos facilities, consistent with the educational objectives of the Institution; and
C. Exos and the Institution have determined that each may best accomplish its objectives by mutual assistance and seek to describe their affiliation in this Agreement.
In consideration of the mutual promises and conditions in this Agreement, Exos and the Institution agree as follows:

4.1. Conduct. Student shall, at all times while on Exos premises, conduct themselves in a professional manner. Student shall refrain from the improper use of alcohol or drugs, and shall not carry any firearms or other weapons while on the Exos premises. Student shall not record, photograph, post on social media or otherwise image events on-site at Exos without express written permission from Exos. Student shall abide by all policies, rules and regulations established by the Exos facility and the Institution.

4.3. Uniform and Identification. Student shall wear the uniform or other clothing as directed by Exos. Student shall display proper identification as directed by Exos.
4.5. Personal Expenses. While at the Exos facility, Student shall be responsible for Student’s personal expenses such as meals, travel, medical care and incidentals.
4.6. Evaluation of Clinical Experience. The Institution and the Facility may terminate this Agreement at any time upon written agreement, though the parties shall attempt, in good faith and using their best efforts, to effectuate the termination to coincide with a normal academic or the Program break.
